changes: MapSwipe has been completely revamped with a brand new look and feel!
Faster and smoother mapping experience across all project types.
Various performance improvements and bug fixes.
- Fixed private project listing by filtering projects based on team membership.
- Improved the Projects page to display the project topic, region, number, and organization (where available).
- Fixed an issue that prevented users from opening projects with progress below 100%.
Added Swipe down and Accessibility in tutorial
Project number moved from the top-right pill into the card title as Topic (219)
Fixed large Display size Project card issue
